title: CrewAI + Casco
summary: CrewAI's CEO and Head of Security explain why they chose Casco for AI agent security testing and what they value about the testing experience.
body_markdown:
# CrewAI Uses Casco to Test the Security of AI Agents


Written by


[Rene Brandel](https://linkedin.com/in/renebrandel)


on


Wed May 28 2025


[CrewAI](https://crewai.com/) builds a platform for creating and running multi-agent systems. The company chose Casco to help test the security of its platform as it enables customers to put AI agents into production.


> Security is such a corner piece at CrewAI, and Casco is the obvious security solution for AI systems. The team impressed me from the get go with the high standard they hold for security. As we empower the creation of production multi-agent crews and automations, we needed a partner with deep expertise in the unique security challenges these systems present. Casco's specialized focus on agentic AI security gives us the confidence to innovate rapidly and securely.


[João (Joe) Moura](https://www.linkedin.com/in/joaomdmoura/)


CEO at CrewAI


## Security testing for systems that act


Moura's account describes the reason for the partnership: CrewAI needed security expertise for the AI agents and automations its platform enables. Casco's[AI application and agent security testing](https://casco.com/solutions/ai-agent-security) examines what an agent can read, which tools it can call, and whether it can act beyond its intended permissions.


## CrewAI's perspective on the testing experience


CrewAI's Head of Security, Matthew Broom, describes the experience this way:


> In my 15 years working in cybersecurity, Casco is the first cybersecurity product that makes security testing high-quality, fast, and easy.


— Matthew Broom, Head of Security at CrewAI


[Watch the CrewAI customer story](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sMDrSBfa1tI) to hear Broom's account.


For teams evaluating their own AI systems, our[published agent security research](https://casco.com/blog/we-hacked-ycombinator-agents) shows examples of permission and data-boundary failures. The[AI pentesting guide](https://casco.com/solutions/ai-pentesting) explains Casco's testing process, scope controls, and optional human review.


---


## About Casco


I founded Casco with Ian Saultz, both of us ex-AWS AI & Security, because we saw the critical need to secure the rapidly evolving landscape of AI agents and applications.


Casco tests approved applications, APIs, infrastructure, and AI systems, validates exploitable findings, and provides remediation guidance.[Explore continuous pentesting](https://casco.com/continuous-pentesting) or[discuss your scope with the team](https://casco.com/book) .


## About CrewAI


CrewAI provides a platform and framework for building teams of AI agents and automating workflows. Learn more at[crewai.com](https://crewai.com/) .
